notes.title: THE JESTER IS OUT!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

My new horror game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451620/The_Jester/?curator_clanid=44385515]The Jester[/url] is now available on steam! I would love to know if you liked the game and what I could improve in my future games.

There's a lot of new stuff coming, stay tuned...

notes.title: THE JESTER - Wishlist now my new horror game!!!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! 

Finally, after a long time I'm happy to announce that in March I'm releasing my new horror game called The Jester. It will be a horror psychological game with a vhs filter. If you are interested, you can add it to your wishlist. Also thanks for the support at Honey are you there. See you soon.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451620/The_Jester/]The Jester Steam Page[/url]

-Psycho

notes.title: Honey Are You There is now FREE!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after several months of releasing my first game [b]Honey Are You There[/b] i decided to make the game available to everyone for [b]free[/b]. At the moment i am making my new horror game "The Whistle" which you can play the demo for free. Thanks for all the reviews you wrote in Honey Are You There and i hope you like my new game that will be released soon!

-Psycho

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
First of all, thanks to everyone who has played my first horror game so far. I've loved reading all your comments and reviews and watching your playthroughs. So again, thanks. Now, on to the news. Almost a week after the release of Honey Are You There here is the first update of the game containing some requested features. 

Whats new:

-Fixed bugs
-Added hints in the game.
-Added objectives
-Enable numpad interaction
-Slower walk


P.S. I am in the making of a new horror game so get ready!!!
More infortmation about my new future project soon :)

notes.title: HONEY ARE YOU THERE IS AVAILABLE NOW!!!
notes.content:
I'am excited to announce that Honey Are You There is ready to be launched. 

As a new game developer, I'm thrilled to release my very first project into the gaming world. I'd like to express my gratitude to those who've purchased my game, and thank them for taking a chance on a new developer.

notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that Honey Are You There? is coming out on July 8th!
